Subject: MSA + Order Form — publicity and logo items

Hi Stephanie / Marissa,

Thanks — we've gone through the redlines you sent. Legal had one outstanding ask around publicity and logo: we need a guarantee that BrightWave will be able to approve any external-facing announcement and that logo use will be limited to the partner page and joint case studies after approval. We returned a redline (attached). Can Redwood confirm:

- Whether you can accept a 60-day review window for case study approvals (from first customer data delivery).
- That Redwood will not issue press releases referencing BrightWave without a mutual sign-off clause.

Also looping procurement for the standard SOC 2 evidence flow. We aim to sign by next week; any blocker on your side?

Best,
Sarah

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — publicity and logo items

Sarah — thanks for the quick read.

Confirming receipt of the Order Form redline. High level response before legal does a formal pass:

- 60-day review window for case studies: acceptable in principle. We'd like the ability to prepare draft promotional material in parallel and circulate for review within that window.
- Press releases: Redwood is comfortable with mutual sign-off. We typically require a 10 business-day review response from counterparties so we can meet marketing timelines; if no response, the release is paused (not auto-approved).
- Logo usage: we can limit to partner page and approved collateral; we'll honour size and color restrictions you specify.

I've attached the MSA redline from our side (20260901_MSA_redline.docx). Marissa / Dev — can you review the publicity language Sarah proposes and flag anything that needs legal escalation? We want to keep this simple for the procurement team.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Director, Business Development

Sarah / team — attaching a short legal note and a proposed clause that aligns with our standard partner publicity language. Key points:

1) Mutual sign-off required for press releases; approval response time: 10 business days.
2) Logo use permitted on Redwood partner assets and joint case studies only. No other public use without written permission.
3) Case study approval: BrightWave has 60 calendar days to review; if not approved in that window, Redwood will not publish.
4) We can add a limited promotional reference right for Redwood to list BrightWave as a customer on our website (partner/customer page) unless BrightWave objects in writing within 10 business days of counterparty providing company-level attribution language.

I've suggested language that keeps the rights narrow and preserves BrightWave's control over press releases. If that looks good, Laura is ready to finalize the MSA redline for legal sign-off.

Attachment: 20260901_MSA_redline.docx

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Counsel, Contracts

Thanks everyone — procurement/legal at BrightWave reviewed your proposed language and it's acceptable with one small tweak: we want the website/customer listing allowance limited to the "Partner & Customers" section only and to specify that any customer quote used in marketing must receive additional approval.

We can sign the MSA & Order Form once you confirm that tweak. I'll also attach a brief DocuSign envelope shortly; please confirm a final copy by EOD.

Cheers,
